en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Yahya, al-Qattan, narrated to us. H; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us. H; and Ibn Numayr narrated to us, and this is his wording. Abdah narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) entered the House with Usamah, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. They closed the door upon them for a long time, then it was opened. I was the first to enter, and I met Bilal. I asked: Where did the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) pray? He said: Between the two front pillars. I forgot to ask him how many units the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had prayed.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Yahya, al-Qattan, überlieferte uns. H; Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns. H; and Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns, and this is his wording. Abdah überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) entered the Haus with Usamah, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. They closed the Tür upon them for a long time, then it was opened. I was the first to enter, and I met Bilal. I asked: Where did der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) pray? Er sagte: Between the two front pillars. I forgot to ask him how many units der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) had betete. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Humayd ibn Masadah narrated to me. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, narrated to us. Abd Allah ibn Awn narrated to us, from Nafi, from Abd Allah ibn Umar. He reached the Ka'bah while the Prophet (peace be upon him), Bilal, and Usamah were inside, and Uthman ibn Talhah had closed the door upon them. They remained there for a while, then the door was opened. The Prophet (peace be upon him) came out, and I climbed the step and entered the House. I asked: Where did the Prophet (peace be upon him) pray? They said: Here. I forgot to ask them how many units he had prayed.
de: Humayd ibn Masadah überlieferte mir. Khalid, meaning Ibn al-Harith, überlieferte uns. Abd Allah ibn Awn überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Abd Allah ibn Umar. He reached the Kaaba while der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), Bilal, and Usamah were inside, and Uthman ibn Talhah had closed the Tür upon them. They remained there for a while, then the Tür was opened. The Prophet (peace be upon him) came out, and I climbed the step and entered the Haus. I asked: Where did der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) pray? They said: Here. I forgot to ask them how many units he had betete. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Layth narrated to us. H; and Ibn Rumh informed us. al-Layth informed us, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from his father. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) entered the House with Usamah ibn Zayd, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. They closed it upon them. When they opened it, I was among the first to enter. I met Bilal and asked him whether the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) had prayed inside. He said: Yes, he prayed between the two Yemeni pillars.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Layth überlieferte uns. H; and Ibn Rumh berichtete uns. al-Layth berichtete uns, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim, from his father. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) entered the Haus with Usamah ibn Zayd, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. They closed it upon them. When they opened it, I was among the first to enter. I met Bilal and asked him whether der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) had betete inside. Er sagte: Yes, he betete between the two Yemeni pillars. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, who informed me that Salim ibn Abd Allah narrated from his father. He said: I saw the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) enter the Ka'bah with Usamah ibn Zayd, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. No one else entered with them, and the door was closed upon them. Abd Allah ibn Umar said: Bilal or Uthman ibn Talhah informed me that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) prayed inside the Ka'bah between the two Yemeni pillars.
de: Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab, who berichtete mir that Salim ibn Abd Allah narrated from his father. Er sagte: I saw der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) enter the Kaaba with Usamah ibn Zayd, Bilal, and Uthman ibn Talhah. No one else entered with them, and the Tür was closed upon them. Abd Allah ibn Umar said: Bilal or Uthman ibn Talhah berichtete mir that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) betete inside the Kaaba between the two Yemeni pillars. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us, both from Ibn Bakr. Abd said: Muhammad ibn Bakr informed us. Ibn Jurayj informed us. He said: I asked Ata: Did you hear Ibn Abbas say, 'You were commanded only to circumambulate, and you were not commanded to enter it'? He said: He did not forbid entering it, but I heard him say: Usamah ibn Zayd informed me that when the Prophet (peace be upon him) entered the House, he supplicated in all its sides and did not pray in it until he came out. When he came out, he prayed two units in front of the House and said: This is the qiblah. I asked: What does 'all its sides' mean, its corners? He said: Rather, every direction facing the House.
de: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte uns, both from Ibn Bakr. Abd said: Muhammad ibn Bakr berichtete uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns. Er sagte: I asked Ata: Did you hear Ibn Abbas say, 'You were commanded only to circumambulate, and you were not commanded to enter it'? Er sagte: He did not forbid entering it, but I heard him say: Usamah ibn Zayd berichtete mir that when der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) entered the Haus, he supplicated in all its sides and did not pray in it until he came out. When he came out, he betete two units in front of the Haus and said: This is the qiblah. I asked: What does 'all its sides' mean, its corners? Er sagte: Rather, every direction facing the Haus. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Shayban ibn Farrukh narrated to us. Hammam narrated to us. Ata narrated to us, from Ibn Abbas, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) entered the Ka'bah, which had six pillars. He stood beside a pillar and supplicated, but he did not pray.
de: Shayban ibn Farrukh überlieferte uns. Hammam überlieferte uns. Ata überlieferte uns, from Ibn Abbas, that der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) entered the Kaaba, which had six pillars. He stood beside a pillar and supplicated, but he did not pray. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Surayj ibn Yunus narrated to me. Hushaym narrated to me. Ismail ibn Abi Khalid informed us. He said: I asked Abd Allah ibn Abi Awfa, the companion of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him): Did the Prophet (peace be upon him) enter the House during his Umrah? He said: No.
de: Surayj ibn Yunus überlieferte mir. Hushaym überlieferte mir. Ismail ibn Abi Khalid berichtete uns. Er sagte: I asked Abd Allah ibn Abi Awfa, the companion of der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm): Did der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) enter the Haus during his Umra? Er sagte: No. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Abu Muawiyah informed us, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha. She said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to me: If your people were not recent in their disbelief, I would demolish the Ka'bah and rebuild it on the foundation of Ibrahim, for Quraysh made it smaller when they built the House, and I would make a rear door for it.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Abu Muawiyah berichtete uns, from Hisham ibn Urwah, from his father, from Aisha. Sie sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said to me: If your people were not recent in their Unglauben, I would demolish the Kaaba and rebuild it on the foundation of Ibrahim, for Quraysh made it smaller when they built the Haus, and I would make a rear Tür for it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated it to us. Ibn Numayr narrated to us, from Hisham, with this chain.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated it to us. Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns, from Hisham, with this chain. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim ibn Abd Allah, that Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Siddiq informed Abd Allah ibn Umar, from Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Do you not see that when your people built the Ka'bah, they left out part of the foundations of Ibrahim? She said: I asked: Messenger of Allah, why do you not restore it to the foundations of Ibrahim? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If your people were not recent in disbelief, I would do so. Abd Allah ibn Umar said: If Aisha heard this from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), I do not think he left touching the two corners next to the Hijr except because the House was not completed on the foundations of Ibrahim.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Salim ibn Abd Allah, that Abd Allah ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Bakr al-Siddiq informed Abd Allah ibn Umar, from Aisha, the wife of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Do you not see that when your people built the Kaaba, they left out part of the foundations of Ibrahim? Sie sagte: I asked: Messenger of Allah, why do you not restore it to the foundations of Ibrahim? The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If your people were not recent in Unglauben, I would do so. Abd Allah ibn Umar said: If Aisha heard this from der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), I do not think he left touching the two corners next to the Hijr except because the Haus was not completed on the foundations of Ibrahim. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu al-Tahir narrated to me. Abd Allah ibn Wahb informed us, from Makhramah. H; and Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli narrated to me. Ibn Wahb narrated to us. Makhramah ibn Bukayr informed me, from his father. He said: I heard Nafi, the freedman of Ibn Umar, say: I heard Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr ibn Abi Quhafah relate to Abd Allah ibn Umar, from Aisha, the wife of the Prophet (peace be upon him), that she said: I heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: If your people were not recent in the pre-Islamic period, or he said disbelief, I would spend the treasure of the Ka'bah in Allah's cause, make its door level with the ground, and include in it what was left out of the Hijr.
de: Abu al-Tahir überlieferte mir. Abd Allah ibn Wahb berichtete uns, from Makhramah. H; and Harun ibn Sa'id al-Ayli überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb überlieferte uns. Makhramah ibn Bukayr berichtete mir, from his father. Er sagte: I heard Nafi, the freedman of Ibn Umar, say: I heard Abd Allah ibn Abi Bakr ibn Abi Quhafah relate to Abd Allah ibn Umar, from Aisha, the wife of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), that she said: I heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: If your people were not recent in the pre-Islamic period, or he said Unglauben, I would spend the treasure of the Kaaba in Allah's cause, make its Tür level with the ground, and include in it what was left out of the Hijr. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Ibn Mahdi narrated to me. Salim ibn Hayyan narrated to us, from Sa'id, meaning Ibn Mina. He said: I heard Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr say: My aunt, meaning Aisha, narrated to me that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Aisha, if your people were not recent in shirk, I would demolish the Ka'bah, bring it level with the ground, make two doors for it, an eastern door and a western door, and add six cubits to it from the Hijr, for Quraysh made it smaller when they built the Ka'bah.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Ibn Mahdi überlieferte mir. Salim ibn Hayyan überlieferte uns, from Sa'id, meaning Ibn Mina. Er sagte: I heard Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr say: My aunt, meaning Aisha, überlieferte mir that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Aisha, if your people were not recent in Schirk, I would demolish the Kaaba, bring it level with the ground, make two Türs for it, an eastern Tür and a western Tür, and add six cubits to it from the Hijr, for Quraysh made it smaller when they built the Kaaba. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Hannad ibn al-Sari narrated to us. Ibn Abi Za'idah narrated to us. Ibn Abi Sulayman informed me, from Ata, who said: When the House was burned during the time of Yazid ibn Muawiyah, when the people of Syria attacked it, Ibn al-Zubayr left it until the people came for the season. He wanted to encourage them, or embolden them, against the people of Syria. When the people departed, he said: People, advise me about the Ka'bah. Should I demolish it and rebuild it, or repair what has become weak? Ibn Abbas said: I have formed an opinion about it. I think you should repair what has become weak and leave a House upon which the people entered Islam and stones upon which the people entered Islam, and upon which the Prophet (peace be upon him) was sent. Ibn al-Zubayr said: If one of you had a house that burned, he would not be satisfied until he renewed it, so how can this be the House of your Lord? I will seek my Lord's guidance for three days, then decide. After three days he resolved to demolish it. The people feared that something from heaven would happen to the first person who climbed it, until a man climbed it and threw down a stone. When no harm came to him, they followed him and demolished it to the ground. Ibn al-Zubayr placed pillars and covered them with coverings until the building rose. He said: I heard Aisha say that the Prophet (peace be upon him) said: If the people were not recent in disbelief, and I did not have the funds to strengthen its building, I would have included five cubits from the Hijr and made one door for entry and one for exit. I now have what I can spend and do not fear the people. He added five cubits from the Hijr, exposed a foundation that people saw, and built upon it. The Ka'bah had been eighteen cubits long. When he added to it, he found it short and added ten cubits to its length, making two doors, one for entering and one for leaving. After Ibn al-Zubayr was killed, al-Hajjaj wrote to Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan, telling him that Ibn al-Zubayr had built upon a foundation witnessed by trustworthy people of Makkah. Abd al-Malik wrote: Leave what he added to its length, return what he added from the Hijr to its former construction, and close the door he opened. So he demolished it and restored it to its former construction.
de: Hannad ibn al-Sari überlieferte uns. Ibn Abi Za'idah überlieferte uns. Ibn Abi Sulayman berichtete mir, from Ata, who said: When the Haus was burned during the time of Yazid ibn Muawiyah, when the people of Syria attacked it, Ibn al-Zubayr left it until the people came for the season. Should I demolish it and rebuild it, or repair what has become weak? Ibn Abbas said: I have formed an opinion about it. I think you should repair what has become weak and leave a Haus upon which the people entered Islam and stones upon which the people entered Islam, and upon which der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) was sent. Ibn al-Zubayr said: If one of you had a house that burned, he would not be satisfied until he renewed it, so how can this be the Haus of your Lord? I will seek my Lord's guidance for drei Tage, then decide. After drei Tage he resolved to demolish it. When no harm came to him, they followed him and demolished it to the ground. Ibn al-Zubayr placed pillars and covered them with coverings until the building rose. en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Muhammad ibn Bakr narrated to us. Ibn Jurayj informed us. He said: I heard Abd Allah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr and al-Walid ibn Ata relate from al-Harith ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Rabiah. Abd Allah ibn Ubayd said: Al-Harith came to Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan during his caliphate. Abd al-Malik said: I do not think Abu Khubayb, meaning Ibn al-Zubayr, heard from Aisha what he claimed to have heard. Al-Harith said: Yes, I heard it from her. He asked: What did you hear her say? He said: She said that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Your people made the building of the House smaller. If they had not recently been in shirk, I would restore what they left out. If your people decide after me to rebuild it, come and I will show you what they left out. He showed her nearly seven cubits. Al-Walid added: The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: I would make two doors for it, level with the ground, one eastern and one western. Do you know why your people raised its door? She said: No. He said: To control who entered it. When a man wanted to enter, they called him to climb, and when he was about to enter, they pushed him and he fell. Abd al-Malik asked al-Harith: Did you hear her say this? He said: Yes. Abd al-Malik tapped his staff for a while and said: I wish I had left it and what it carried.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn Bakr überlieferte uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns. Er sagte: I heard Abd Allah ibn Ubayd ibn Umayr and al-Walid ibn Ata relate from al-Harith ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Rabiah. If your people decide after me to rebuild it, come and I will show you what they left out. He showed her nearly seven cubits. en: Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Jablah narrated it to us. Abu Asim narrated to us. H; and Abd ibn Humayd informed us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Both of them narrated from Ibn Jurayj, with this chain, like the hadith of Ibn Bakr.
de: Muhammad ibn Amr ibn Jablah narrated it to us. Abu Asim überlieferte uns. H; and Abd ibn Humayd berichtete uns. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Both of them narrated from Ibn Jurayj, with this chain, like the hadith of Ibn Bakr. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Abd Allah ibn Bakr al-Sahmi narrated to us. Hatim ibn Abi Saghirah narrated to us, from Abu Qazaah, that Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan, while circumambulating the House, said: May Allah fight Ibn al-Zubayr, how he lies about the Mother of the Believers, saying that he heard her say that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: Aisha, if your people were not recent in disbelief, I would demolish the House and add to it from the Hijr, for your people made the building smaller. Al-Harith ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Rabiah said: Do not say this, Commander of the Believers. I heard the Mother of the Believers relate this. He said: If I had heard it before demolishing it, I would have left it as Ibn al-Zubayr built it.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Abd Allah ibn Bakr al-Sahmi überlieferte uns. Hatim ibn Abi Saghirah überlieferte uns, from Abu Qazaah, that Abd al-Malik ibn Marwan, while circumambulating the Haus, said: May Allah fight Ibn al-Zubayr, how he lies about the Mother of the Believers, saying that he heard her say that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: Aisha, if your people were not recent in Unglauben, I would demolish the Haus and add to it from the Hijr, for your people made the building smaller. Al-Harith ibn Abd Allah ibn Abi Rabiah said: Do not say this, Commander of the Believers. I heard the Mother of the Believers relate this. Er sagte: If I had heard it before demolishing it, I would have left it as Ibn al-Zubayr built it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Sa'id ibn Mansur narrated to us. Abu al-Ahwas narrated to us. Ash'ath ibn Abi al-Sha'tha narrated to us, from al-Aswad ibn Yazid, from Aisha. She said: I asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) about the wall: Is it part of the House? He said: Yes. I asked: Why did they not include it in the House? He said: Your people lacked the funds. I asked: Why is its door raised? He said: Your people did that so they could let in whom they wished and prevent whom they wished. If your people were not recent in the pre-Islamic period and I feared their hearts would reject it, I would consider including the wall in the House and bringing its door level with the ground.
de: Sa'id ibn Mansur überlieferte uns. Abu al-Ahwas überlieferte uns. Ash'ath ibn Abi al-Sha'tha überlieferte uns, from al-Aswad ibn Yazid, from Aisha. Sie sagte: I asked der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) about the Mauer: Is it part of the Haus? Er sagte: Yes. I asked: Why did they not include it in the Haus? Er sagte: Your people lacked the funds. I asked: Why is its Tür raised? Er sagte: Your people did that so they could let in whom they wished and prevent whom they wished. If your people were not recent in the pre-Islamic period and I feared their hearts would reject it, I would consider including the Mauer in the Haus and bringing its Tür level with the ground. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. He said: Ubayd Allah, meaning Ibn Musa, narrated to us. Shayban narrated to us, from Ash'ath ibn Abi al-Sha'tha, from al-Aswad ibn Yazid, from Aisha. She said: I asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) about the Hijr. He gave the hadith with the meaning of the hadith of Abu al-Ahwas and said: I asked why its door was raised and could be reached only by a ladder. He said: For fear that their hearts would recoil.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated it to us. Er sagte: Ubayd Allah, meaning Ibn Musa, überlieferte uns. Shayban überlieferte uns, from Ash'ath ibn Abi al-Sha'tha, from al-Aswad ibn Yazid, from Aisha. Sie sagte: I asked der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) about the Hijr. He gave the hadith with the meaning of the hadith of Abu al-Ahwas and said: I asked why its Tür was raised and could be reached only by a ladder. Er sagte: For fear that their hearts would recoil. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. He said: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Abd Allah ibn Abbas, that he said: Al-Fadl ibn Abbas was riding behind the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him). A woman from Khath'am came asking him for a ruling, and al-Fadl began looking at her and she at him. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) turned al-Fadl's face toward the other side. She said: Messenger of Allah, Allah's obligation upon His servants concerning Hajj has reached my father as an old man who cannot remain firm on a riding animal. May I perform Hajj on his behalf? He said: Yes. This was during the Farewell Hajj.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Er sagte: I read to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, from Abd Allah ibn Abbas, that he said: Al-Fadl ibn Abbas was riding behind der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm). A woman from Khath'am came asking him for a ruling, and al-Fadl began looking at her and she at him. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) turned al-Fadl's face toward the other side. Sie sagte: Messenger of Allah, Allah's obligation upon His servants concerning Hadsch has reached my father as an old man who cannot remain firm on a riding animal. May I perform Hadsch on his behalf? Er sagte: Yes. This was during the Farewell Hadsch. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ali ibn Khashram narrated to me. Isa informed us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Shihab. Sulayman ibn Yasar narrated to us, from Ibn Abbas, from al-Fadl, that a woman from Khath'am said: Messenger of Allah, my father is an old man, and Allah's obligation of Hajj is due from him, but he cannot sit upright on his camel. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Perform Hajj on his behalf.
de: Ali ibn Khashram überlieferte mir. Isa berichtete uns, from Ibn Jurayj, from Ibn Shihab. Sulayman ibn Yasar überlieferte uns, from Ibn Abbas, from al-Fadl, that a woman from Khath'am said: Messenger of Allah, my father is an old man, and Allah's obligation of Hadsch is due from him, but he cannot sit upright on his Kamel. The Prophet (peace be upon him) said: Perform Hadsch on his behalf. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Ibn Abi Umar all narrated from Ibn Uyaynah. Abu Bakr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Ibrahim ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, the freedman of Ibn Abbas, from Ibn Abbas, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), that he met a caravan at al-Rawha and said: Who are these people? They said: Muslims. They asked: Who are you? He said: The Messenger of Allah. A woman lifted a child to him and said: Is Hajj valid for this one? He said: Yes, and you will have a reward.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Zuhayr ibn Harb, and Ibn Abi Umar all narrated from Ibn Uyaynah. Abu Bakr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Ibrahim ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, the freedman of Ibn Abbas, from Ibn Abbas, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), that he met a caravan at al-Rawha and said: Who are these people? They said: Muslims. They asked: Who are you? Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah. A woman lifted a Kind to him and said: Is Hadsch valid for this one? Er sagte: Yes, and you will have a Belohnung. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Kurayb, Muhammad ibn al-Ala, narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Sufyan, from Muhammad ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas. He said: A woman lifted her child and said: Messenger of Allah, is Hajj valid for this one? He said: Yes, and you will have a reward.
de: Abu Kurayb, Muhammad ibn al-Ala, überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Sufyan, from Muhammad ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas. Er sagte: A woman lifted her Kind and said: Messenger of Allah, is Hadsch valid for this one? Er sagte: Yes, and you will have a Belohnung. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me. Abd al-Rahman narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Ibrahim ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, that a woman lifted a child and said: Messenger of Allah, is Hajj valid for this one? He said: Yes, and you will have a reward.
de: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte mir. Abd al-Rahman überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Ibrahim ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, that a woman lifted a Kind and said: Messenger of Allah, is Hadsch valid for this one? Er sagte: Yes, and you will have a Belohnung. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. Abd al-Rahman narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas, with the same meaning.
de: Ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. Abd al-Rahman überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns, from Muhammad ibn Uqbah, from Kurayb, from Ibn Abbas, with the same meaning. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Yazid ibn Harun narrated to us. al-Rabi ibn Muslim al-Qurashi informed us, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abu Hurayra. He said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) addressed us and said: People, Allah has made Hajj obligatory upon you, so perform Hajj. A man asked: Every year, Messenger of Allah? He remained silent until the man said it three times. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If I had said yes, it would have become obligatory and you would not have been able to fulfill it. Then he said: Leave me with what I have left for you. Those before you were destroyed by asking too many questions and disagreeing with their prophets. When I command you to do something, do as much of it as you can, and when I forbid you from something, leave it.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Yazid ibn Harun überlieferte uns. al-Rabi ibn Muslim al-Qurashi berichtete uns, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, from Abu Hurayra. Er sagte: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) addressed us and said: People, Allah has made Hadsch obligatory upon you, so perform Hadsch. A man asked: Every year, Messenger of Allah? He remained silent until the man said it drei times. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: If I had said yes, it would have become obligatory and you would not have been able to fulfill it. Then he said: Leave me with what I have left for you. Those before you were destroyed by asking too many questions and disagreeing with their prophets. When I command you to do something, do as much of it as you can, and when I forbid you from something, leave it. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Harmalah ibn Yahya al-Tujibi narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab. Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib said: Abu Hurayra used to relate that he heard the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) say: Whatever I forbid you, avoid it; and whatever I command you, do as much of it as you can. Those before you were destroyed only by their many questions and their disagreement with their prophets.
de: Harmalah ibn Yahya al-Tujibi überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab. Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman and Sa'id ibn al-Musayyib said: Abu Hurayra used to relate that he heard der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) say: Whatever I forbid you, avoid it; and whatever I command you, do as much of it as you can. Those before you were destroyed only by their many questions and their disagreement with their prophets. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf narrated to me. Abu Salamah, Mansur ibn Salamah al-Khuza'i, narrated to us. Layth informed us, from Yazid ibn al-Had, from Ibn Shihab, with this chain, exactly the same.
de: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Abi Khalaf überlieferte mir. Abu Salamah, Mansur ibn Salamah al-Khuza'i, überlieferte uns. Layth berichtete uns, from Yazid ibn al-Had, from Ibn Shihab, with this chain, exactly the same. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb narrated to us. Abu Muawiyah narrated to us. H; and Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. Both narrated from al-Amash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayra. H; and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. al-Mughirah, meaning al-Hizami, narrated to us. H; and Ibn Abi Umar narrated to us. Sufyan narrated to us. Both narrated from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. H; and Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh narrated it to us. My father narrated to us. Shubah narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, who heard Abu Hurayra. H; and Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ma'mar informed us, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, from Abu Hurayra. All of them said, from the Prophet (peace be upon him): Leave me with what I have left for you. In Hammam's hadith it says: Leave what I have left for you, for those before you were destroyed. Then they mentioned something like the hadith of al-Zuhri from Sa'id and Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayra.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb überlieferte uns. Abu Muawiyah überlieferte uns. H; and Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. Both narrated from al-Amash, from Abu Salih, from Abu Hurayra. H; and Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. al-Mughirah, meaning al-Hizami, überlieferte uns. H; and Ibn Abi Umar überlieferte uns. Sufyan überlieferte uns. Both narrated from Abu al-Zinad, from al-Araj, from Abu Hurayra. H; and Ubayd Allah ibn Muadh narrated it to us. My father überlieferte uns. Shubah überlieferte uns, from Muhammad ibn Ziyad, who heard Abu Hurayra. H; and Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte uns. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from Hammam ibn Munabbih, from Abu Hurayra. All of them said, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm): Leave me with what I have left for you. In Hammam's hadith it says: Leave what I have left for you, for those before you were destroyed. Then they mentioned something like the hadith of al-Zuhri from Sa'id and Abu Salamah, from Abu Hurayra. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah. Nafi informed me, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said: A woman should not travel for three days except with a mahram accompanying her.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb and Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna überlieferte uns. They said: Yahya, al-Qattan, überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah. Nafi berichtete mir, from Ibn Umar, that der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) said: A woman should not reisen for drei Tage except with a mahram accompanying her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah narrated to us. H; and Ibn Numayr narrated to us. My father narrated to us. All of them narrated from Ubayd Allah, with this chain. Abu Bakr's narration says: more than three. Ibn Numayr's narration from his father says: three, except with a mahram accompanying her.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abd Allah ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah überlieferte uns. H; and Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. My father überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Ubayd Allah, with this chain. Abu Bakr's narration says: more than drei. Ibn Numayr's narration from his father says: drei, except with a mahram accompanying her. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.
